lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Tiger LooseNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 41THE PARK LANE MURDERER STILL AT LARGEThe Colonel goes over the wall into Manchester Street, and is gone. The Yard finds a cab in Marylebone, and a hat in a gutter, and nothing else. By the middle of the week he is on a boat for the Continent, with a long leather case in the hold, and a ticket in another name. He never forgives, and he has a great deal of patience. London goes back to its newspapers, and Park Lane is forgotten. You remember it.
